findings.summary: isPublished(articles.get(slug)) throws when the linked slug has no matching article file, crashing the entire build.
findings.mechanism: articles.get(match[1]) returns undefined for any /blog/<slug> link that doesn't correspond to a file in packages/content/articles (typo, renamed/deleted post, or a slug that differs from the filename). isPublished then does `if (article.draft)` on undefined, throwing a TypeError that propagates out of the remark transform and fails the whole site build — for exactly the kind of broken-link case this feature is supposed to handle gracefully.
